# Exoticca

> > Exoticca offers organized tour packages and guided circuits to exotic destinations worldwide, featuring all-inclusive vacation packages with flights, hotels, and cultural experiences.

Exoticca specializes in curated multi-destination tours across continents, from Mayan ruins in Central America to safaris in Africa, temple tours in Southeast Asia, and cultural circuits through Europe. The platform provides comprehensive vacation packages combining transportation, accommodations, and guided experiences for travelers seeking organized international adventures.

## Key Topics

- viajes-organizados (organized tours)
- circuitos-turisticos (tourist circuits)
- paquetes-turisticos (tour packages)
- paquetes-vacacionales (vacation packages)
- tours-guiados (guided tours)
- ruinas-mayas (Mayan ruins)
- turismo-cultural (cultural tourism)
- mercados-navidenos (Christmas markets)
- safaris
- Southeast Asia temple tours
- European circuits
- Multi-country packages
- All-inclusive travel
- Exotic destinations
- Adventure travel

## Regional Tour Collections

- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Sudeste Asiático](https://www.exoticca.com/es/asia/sudeste-asiatico): Southeast Asia packages: Thailand, Myanmar, cultural temple tours
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Extremo Oriente](https://www.exoticca.com/es/asia/extremo-oriente): Far East packages: China, Japan, Korea guided tour circuits
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Europa Central](https://www.exoticca.com/es/europa/europa-central): Central Europe tour packages: Germany, Austria, Slovenia circuits
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a América Central](https://www.exoticca.com/es/america/america-central): Central America packages: Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama Mayan tours
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a África del Sur](https://www.exoticca.com/es/africa/africa-del-sur): Southern Africa safaris: Namibia, South Africa, Victoria Falls tours
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Índico](https://www.exoticca.com/es/africa/indico): Indian Ocean tours: Mauritius, Seychelles, Madagascar beach packages

## South America Tours

- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Chile](https://www.exoticca.com/es/america/america-del-sur/chile): Chile packages: Easter Island, Atacama Desert, Patagonia tours
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Ecuador](https://www.exoticca.com/es/america/america-del-sur/ecuador): Ecuador tours: Galapagos Islands, Amazon, Quito packages
- [Circuitos y Viajes Organizados a Bolivia](https://www.exoticca.com/es/america/america-del-sur/bolivia): Bolivia tours: Uyuni salt flats, Lake Titicaca, Peru combo packages
